support: Two adjoining 100 km squares; 20 km cells. Retain only cells with 400 km² land in the saved Natural Earth main-island mask; exclude R5C07 and R5C08, 104 detections. No zero-count cells deliberately removed.
land_area_caveat: Full-land classification is relative to the generalized source boundary, not a claim of survey-accurate coastal geometry.
variable: Raw nominal/high-confidence S-NPP VIIRS detections, 1–30 September 2026 UTC
global_weights: I and C: row-standardised rook; General G: binary rook; same graph
local_weights: I and C: row-standardised rook. Gi*: binary rook plus self weight 1. This difference is explicit and required by the selected definitions.
local_null: Hold focal value fixed; sample k distinct indices from the other n-1 values without replacement. Same random draws for all three local statistics at a focal cell.
local_p: Inclusive lower/upper Monte Carlo tails, add one; two-sided=min(1,2*min(p_lower,p_upper)). B=9999; seed=5230. Each method has a separate 48-test BH family.
BH_caveat: BH is shown as an exploratory FDR adjustment, not guaranteed control under arbitrary spatial dependence. Bonferroni counts are provided as a dependence-robust family-wise comparison.
global_null: Unrestricted permutation of the same counts on fixed cells/weights. I and General G upper-tail; C lower-tail for the stated alternatives.
